llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to let an agent assist with a PAPI/WhatsApp automation account. Keep the API key private, confirm sends and group/catalog/instance changes deliberately, and configure webhooks or WebSockets only for trusted HTTPS/WSS destinations allowed to receive WhatsApp event data.
